value.rationale: The 2007 primary paper expressly leaves this natural inscribed optimization unsolved while solving the complementary covering problem. Exact all-dimensional radii, positive optimality measures, the sharp r/R=(d-1)/(d+1) cap-contact transition, and smaller-radius-independent transverse semiaxis in the second regime supply a motivated complete classification with use in conic geometric approximation.
